payload.entry: LANDER FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE: Reviewed every phase note. sase-1tj.1 note #1 general launch-time cwd hazard is causally owned by active epic sase-1tc, whose phase sase-1tc.1/child efc66a420b introduced macro-body source-boundary execution before workspace entry. Via /sase_new_task, searched all-status bug tasks, swept recent tasks and active epics, then appended detailed evidence to sase-1tc; no new duplicate task. sase-1tj.1 note #2 splits into (a) two launch-admission assertions already tracked by sase-1tl, (b) two chop cancellation assertions already tracked by sase-1tm, and (c) gate-capacity flake sase-1tn. All five exact tests pass now on fbfaf07123 with companion 4e5c1b9730; 18 passed including all 13 guard tests. Declined new tasks for (a)/(b) because this is the already-diagnosed older-primary/newer-core pairing, recorded passing evidence on both tasks and causal epic sase-1tc.3.1.6. Corroborated (c) on existing flake sase-1tn with attribution to phase check c8fbf549a33e3fd56ae2869a4674661a; serial pass does not retire the intermittent report. Phase .2 skill redeploy and phase .3 Apollo plugin refresh remain documented post-landing activation steps, not new defect tasks; no global install attempted. No other PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP entries were present.

LANDING REVIEW / REMAINING WORK: All three closed phase beads and every note reviewed. Macro commit 73b3350 (plugin) and 43ef590bb6 (sase docs) preserve month, target, suffix, no-overwrite and runtime-open rules; raw-source regression passes. Phase .2 commit 03a48ab7fc implements the selected warn branch and advisory top-level context without changing obligations, but is incomplete: commit_scan_roots is a duplicate enumeration, not the planned extraction consumed by collect_dirty_state. Concrete temporary-git reproduction: configured target research -> B plus opened research -> A, both dirty; dirty_configured_sibling_repos returns only A due to seen_names, commit_scan_roots includes A and B, and find_unscanned_writes(extra_paths=(B/report.md,), include_run_paths=False) returns empty. Also _match_inventory_record collects all projects and ignores owning project in the repair command: _suggest_fix for bob-cli primary research yields sase repo open research, which opens this host project sase research, so the instruction moves a report into the wrong repo. Shared classification/repair policy is all Python and must honor the Rust backend boundary. These are remaining phase-.2/epic work, not new follow-up tasks. Planning one medium tale to repair them and close this epic. No epic-symbol entries currently exist. No parent_bead is displayed.

LANDING VERIFICATION / INTEGRATION: At fbfaf07123, freshly fetched origin/master has no additional commits. Reviewed non-epic changes since creation/first epic commit: 5f4807e61b repository-integration facade split, 4e5c1b9730 cancellation contract, 1ccd5c0579 update lock waiting, fbfaf07123 compact-list cleanup. None adds a competing research writer or guard consumer; cancellation drift is integrated by 4e5c1b9730 and the four affected tests now pass. Focused verification: 18 passed in 6.55s (13 guard tests plus all five phase-.1 follow-up tests); plugin source regression 1 passed. Phase .3 recovery verified against actual commits df90f1ef (sase:1), b83df6f6 (bob-cli:10), 3db5ee60 (tailnet:2), each carrying sase-1tj.3. All 13 committed Git blob IDs exactly match git hash-object of the parked Apollo originals under ~/.local/state/sase/recovered-research/<project>/202611; commit_and_park was honored with three extra bob-cli reports beyond the original ten. Apollo macro inspection still finds the launch-time sase repo path research expressions. Reinstall/redeploy activation remains required after landed code, as the approved plan states. Do not wait for a future commit/CI result to perform the repair tales closeout.

FINAL LANDER CHECKPOINT: Audited remote repo opens on Apollo (-p sase/bob-cli/tailnet -w 0, read-only purpose) followed by git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all confirm all three primary research checkouts are clean; the recovered report paths now exist there as committed files after sync. This independently verifies the remaining phase-.3 clean-primary claim. Rechecked epic-symbols: empty. Repair tale sase_plan_research_commit_guard_finish.md passed --explain validation and revalidation with zero warnings; it covers both reproduced detector defects, shared Rust policy, verification, drift review and this epics full same-turn closeout. No primary tracked source files changed during this landing review, so no new just check run was required; 19 focused tests passed in total. Epic and original plan remain open intentionally pending that repair.
